Collect Child Process Output

Source: R/63-BenchMemory_utils.R
bench_child_log.Rd

Appends the buffered stdout/stderr of a callr::r_bg() child to a rolling log. Only the last n lines are kept, so a chatty child cannot grow the parent heap during a long measurement.

Usage

bench_child_log(log, process, n = 100L)

Arguments

log

character. Lines collected by earlier calls; the returned vector keeps at most n of the combined old and new lines.

process

A callr::r_bg() handle whose output and error pipes are read. Pipe errors (e.g. after the child has been reaped) are ignored, so already collected lines are preserved.

n

integer. Maximum number of lines to keep. Default: 100L.

Value

A character vector of at most n lines.
